description: Divisional Secretariat of Matara Four Gravets - Notice under Pilgrimage Ordinance that the Ruhunu Uduwap Maha Perahera of Matara Weherahena Purwarama Temple will be conducted on 03.12.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the date for the Ruhunu Uduwap Maha Perahera (a religious/cultural festival) under the Pilgrimage Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). This falls under cultural/religious administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
